name: lying supine straight knee raise
description: A lying straight-leg raise that lifts the leg with the knee locked. It wakes up the quads and hip flexors in a gentle way.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
